summary: Add inactive generation-bearing job launch intent and outcome contracts (unit 7a)

replay.detail: Jobs-only refolding retains generation and receipt path, refuses unversioned launch transitions, duplicate intents and generation-mismatched refusals. No shared writer or generic fold changes.

schema.detail: No table or schema-version changes; job.recorded gains launch-intent and launch-refused records.

rules.detail: Admission is not wired. Intent history is not execution authority; no runtime caller or activation.

compatibility.detail: Pure B6 outcomes use holderOutcome, never exit status. All four caps require Measured and true. Stable keeper/job-generation names support unit 8. Counters-unavailable is typed, never zero.

manual.detail: No activation, configuration defaults or deployment changes.

recovery.detail: Unit 8 owns restart recovery: uncertain intent becomes unknown-after-host-loss, never rerun.
